defects.DESCRIPTION: 4 declared risk limits (MAX_DAILY_LOSS, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_LOSS, STALE_DATA, SLIPPAGE_LIMIT) could never fire: cycle.py:287 built a fresh RiskGuard each cycle, note_close() had no caller anywhere in v1_upgrade, and cycle.py:289-290 hardcoded data_age_seconds=0 / slippage_bps=0.
defects.REPRODUCTION: research/hermes/trader_v1/v1_upgrade/audit/staged_fix/offline_repro.py -> SHOULD-REJECT-BUT-ALLOWED = 8/32 (09-30:6, 10-01:2); and ledger risk_reasons histogram = {MAX_POSITION: N} only.
defects.AFFECTED_TRADES: 32/32 executed without the 4 declared protections; 8 opens demonstrably should have been rejected
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: declared rule != wired rule: guard state ownership undefined (per-cycle construction), no accounting call site, placeholder inputs
defects.FIX: gates.py rebuilt from ledger CLOSE/PNL (rebuild_risk_state) + same-source data_age_seconds + last realized slippage; cycle.py wired. Operator-authorised 2026-10-02.
defects.VALIDATION: 12/12 staged regression + 14/14 permanent suite; production --dry-run denied entry (WAIT_RISK:MAX_DAILY_LOSS,MAX_CONSECUTIVE_LOSS); ledger chain OK

defects.DESCRIPTION: DUPLICATE_ORDER guard is structurally unreachable in production: cycle.py always passes already_sent=set(), and order_id=f'{MAGIC}-{NOW}' is unique per cycle, so intent.order_id can never be in already_sent.
defects.REPRODUCTION: gates.RiskGuard.evaluate() with the runtime intent shape; static read of cycle.py:288.
defects.AFFECTED_TRADES: n/a (never fired) - the guard provides no protection
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: no persisted sent-order set; order_id derived from a per-cycle timestamp

defects.DESCRIPTION: KILL_SWITCH is never set by any runtime path (logical kill_switch defaults False; no config/cron/ledger hook sets it), so it cannot halt trading.
defects.REPRODUCTION: static read of cycle.py: no set_kill_switch call.

defects.DESCRIPTION: Ledger PNL events recorded only the price component (no commission/swap); the declared ledger PnL (e.g. 13.97 in the 09-28..10-01 window) differs from broker net (8.78). Daily-loss accounting on the old build therefore understated losses.
defects.REPRODUCTION: V1_TRADE_RECONCILIATION.json identities: ledger_pnl_sum_profit_component vs broker_net_sum; V1_LEDGER_REPLAY_AUDIT.json cross_check.
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: PNL event schema omitted cost fields
defects.FIX: new PNL events add commission/swap (2026-10-02); guard uses net basis. Historical events remain price-only.
defects.VALIDATION: rebuild uses net for new events; cross_check match on price component

defects.DESCRIPTION: Broker SL/TP exits are observed only at the next reconcile; observed detection lag up to 112397s (~31h). Derived counters (closed count, consecutive loss, daily loss) lag real time.
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: pull-based reconciliation on a 15-minute cycle, no push/streaming

defects.DESCRIPTION: broker_time_utc and live_state.last_bar_utc are UTC+3 server-frame but named 'utc'; a UTC reader sees 'future' times (measured offset 10800s).
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: server-frame timestamps stored under utc names

defects.DESCRIPTION: Early staleness computation mixed UTC 'now' with server-frame bar time -> one negative data_age (-10590.2s) at ledger seq 1 (that cycle was WAIT_POSITION_OPEN, no order).
defects.VALIDATION: regression age_same_source; production dry-run data_age=17.0s (positive, plausible)

defects.DESCRIPTION: Host restart missed one scheduled cycle (14:03Z) and there is no dedicated watchdog / catch-up; the sole scheduler is the OpenClaw cron job (it did recover at 14:18Z).

Data-anomaly paths of the wired limits are not fail-closed: if the broker history query fails, daily/consecutive counters under-count (see D005); slippage with no fill history defaults to 0 (no protection for the first order).
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: missing-data semantics default to 'no protection' rather than 'deny'
defects.FIX: candidate: deny entries when reconcile/broker data is missing (fail-closed); needs separate authorisation

defects.DESCRIPTION: gates.Ledger.replay() open_positions can contain None/0 non-ticket keys from rejected sends (ledger ORDER_SEND with ok=false still enters open_positions).
defects.AFFECTED_TRADES: n/a (engine verdicts use MT5 live positions)
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: replay adds all ORDER_SEND regardless of ok; rejected sends have order_id None

defects.DESCRIPTION: order_send_enabled=true (operator) while the risk guard was inert meant the engine sent real demo orders with only MAX_POSITION/SPREAD protection; declared risk limits were decoration.
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: V1-D001 combined with a live send flag
defects.FIX: V1-D001 fixed; guard now blocks (dry-run denied entry 2026-10-02).

defects.DESCRIPTION: The audited 'V1' is a BASELINE_TRANSITION control arm (frozen 9-state labeler + successor table), explicitly NOT Hermes capability and NOT an alpha model; the registry itself marks the predictor UNSUPPORTED (R8-B). Any 'performance' figure is a control observation, not evidence of strategy alpha.
defects.REPRODUCTION: registry/v1_upgrade_registry.json; signal_baseline.py disclaimer; mapping has no profit/win semantics.

defects.DESCRIPTION: No statistical evidence of tradable alpha: n=32 closed trades, net -17.86, win-rate 0.375, t=-0.293, bootstrap 95% CI [-4.10, +3.27] includes 0, permutation p=0.777, cost ladder stays negative at 0.5x. Sample is far below any effective-n threshold.
defects.ROOT_CAUSE: no edge in the control arm + tiny sample
